hypothesis: With m2 fixed at 0.5 on data_seed 0, the N=128 force ceiling seen for seed 23 at 24000 steps replicates on seed 22. N=128 seed 22 (4 layers, d_model=64, e in [0, 0.5], best-of-3 controls) is trained to 24000 steps. Its final trained force R2 stays at least 0.04 below the same seed's 12000-step N=64 value of 0.8398 (layer 1), and it gains no more than 0.03 between steps 12000 and 24000. Values are read from probes_final at the best-margin layer, unrounded, and the layer is reported. A best layer other than 1 is flagged as cross-layer. Within-run values are read as that layer's control plus margin, never from the max-over-layers trajectory field. Horizon check: step-12000 trained force R2 must be within 0.03 of the 12000-step N=128 seed-22 run (0.6894, layer 3); otherwise the result is reported as horizon-confounded.
expected_if_true: Final trained force R2 <= 0.7998 and step-12000 to step-24000 gain <= 0.03. accel_step headroom-normalised margin in [0.60, 0.85].
expected_if_false: Final trained force R2 >= 0.8198 (gap to N=64 <= 0.02), or step-12000 to step-24000 gain >= 0.04. Any outcome between these bands is inconclusive.
